location: Western Forests — Old-growth elven forests west of the fort.
rewardEnvelope: the pay is plain coin, and the road's yield goes to the company
stakeIfLost: If Arlette is not returned, the fort will lose its river-toll right when the lord strips its license and hands the toll-house to a rival, cutting the fort's income.
arrival: turned up with the tally-carts · named a price before being asked
OPPOSES: burner · hold Arlette until the pledge is fulfilled at the root-circle

cast.name: Arlette
cast.who: Riverfront performer who fled after breaking a toll oath, restless and quick-tongued.
cast.want: to keep the oath's token safe until she can honor the pledge

bible.goal: to bring Arlette to the fort to answer for breaking a toll oath

relevantLore.name: Tarfen Crossing
relevantLore.blurb: A mud-churned toll crossing where riverfolk and wagons pass daily.

arcStep: Search Tarfen Crossing for signs the fugitive passed, following the fort's lead
